description: Classification suggestions for a single document.

title.description: A short, descriptive title for this document, at most 128 characters.
title.title: Title

tags.description: All topic labels you would suggest from the document itself, e.g. 'Insurance', 'Car', 'Warranty'. Always include every suggested name here, even when it matches an available tag.
tags.title: Tags

matched_tags.description: Names copied exactly from tags that mean the same thing as an available tag. Align each name by position with tag_ids.
matched_tags.title: Matched Tags

tag_ids.description: Available tag IDs matching matched_tags, in the same order. Only use IDs shown in the prompt.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

correspondents.description: Who this document is from or was sent to, not every party merely mentioned. A document has a single correspondent, so give at most 4, best first, and prefer one name over several names for the same organisation. Always include every suggested name here, even when it matches an available correspondent.
correspondents.title: Correspondents

matched_correspondents.description: Names copied exactly from correspondents that identify the same entity as an available correspondent. Align each name by position with correspondent_ids.
matched_correspondents.title: Matched Correspondents

correspondent_ids.description: Available correspondent IDs matching matched_correspondents, in the same order. Only use IDs shown in the prompt.
correspondent_ids.title: Correspondent Ids

document_types.description: What kind of document this is, e.g. 'Invoice', 'Contract', 'Bank Statement', 'Letter'. Never use its subject or sender as a document type. A document has a single type, so give at most 4, best first. Always include every suggested name here, even when it matches an available document type.
document_types.title: Document Types

matched_document_types.description: Names copied exactly from document_types that mean the same thing as an available document type. Align each name by position with document_type_ids.
matched_document_types.title: Matched Document Types

document_type_ids.description: Available document type IDs matching matched_document_types, in the same order. Only use IDs shown in the prompt.
document_type_ids.title: Document Type Ids

storage_paths.description: Folder-style filing location, e.g. 'Finance/Invoices'. Leave empty unless a filing location is clearly implied - never put tags, document types or correspondents here. A document has a single storage path, so give at most 4, best first. Always include every suggested name here, even when it matches an available storage path.
storage_paths.title: Storage Paths

matched_storage_paths.description: Names copied exactly from storage_paths that mean the same filing location as an available storage path. Align each name by position with storage_path_ids.
matched_storage_paths.title: Matched Storage Paths

storage_path_ids.description: Available storage path IDs matching matched_storage_paths, in the same order. Only use IDs shown in the prompt.
storage_path_ids.title: Storage Path Ids

dates.description: Up to 3 dates relevant to this document, each formatted YYYY-MM-DD. The most important is the date the document was issued.
dates.title: Dates
